blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — Eight crew members of a cargo boat were rescued after it partially sank off Dalupiri Island in Calayan, Cagayan, on Saturday, Oct. 31, according to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) and local disaster response teams. The M/B Rose Marie 1 reportedly experienced engine trouble and took in water, causing it to partially sink. Rescuers from PCG Station-Calayan and the municipal disaster response office initially rescued five crew members and brought them ashore in Barangay Magsidel.
